fields.name: Syrniki
fields.description: Mix the cottage cheese with an egg, sugar, a little salt, and flour. Shape the mixture into small pancakes and coat them lightly with flour. Fry the syrnyky in butter over medium heat until golden on both sides.

fields.name: French Omelet
fields.description: Beat the eggs with a little salt. Melt the butter in a pan and pour in the eggs. Cook over medium heat until the omelette is set and lightly golden. You can make it in different shapes, depending on your preference. Enjoy your meal!

fields.name: Brownies
fields.description:
First, melt the chocolate and butter in a double boiler. Make sure the water does not touch the bottom of the bowl, then set the mixture aside to cool slightly.

Beat the eggs with the sugar until light and foamy. You can use 310 g of white sugar or a mix of 200 g white and 110 g brown sugar. Add the oil, a little salt, vanilla extract, and the cooled chocolate mixture. Mix well.

Sift in the flour and cocoa powder, then gently mix with a spatula until combined.

Line a 20×20 cm baking pan with parchment paper and pour in the chocolate mixture. Bake at 180°C for 25–30 minutes. The brownie should still be slightly soft in the center when you take it out, as it will become firmer while cooling. Enjoy your meal!

fields.name: Caesar
fields.description:
First, prepare the homemade mayonnaise. Mix an egg with mustard and slowly add olive oil while whisking until the mixture becomes thick and creamy.

Season the chicken fillet with salt and fry it in a pan until golden and fully cooked. Let it cool slightly and cut it into small pieces.

Cut the tomatoes and lettuce leaves, then add the chicken. Mix the homemade mayonnaise with a little Parmesan and add it to the salad. Gently mix everything together and top with extra Parmesan.

Enjoy your meal!

fields.name: Pasta Carbonara
fields.description:
First, prepare the pasta dough by mixing flour, eggs, a little salt, and water. Knead until you get a smooth dough, then let it rest for a short time.

Next, cut the pork belly into small pieces and fry it until golden and crispy. Add black pepper and garlic for extra flavor.

For the sauce, mix an egg yolk with grated Parmesan and a little pasta water until smooth and creamy.

Roll out the dough and cut it into thin strips. Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until tender. Add the pasta to the pan with the pork belly, then remove it from the heat and mix in the Parmesan sauce. Stir well until the sauce becomes creamy. Enjoy your meal!

fields.name: Pizza
fields.description:
First, prepare the dough. Use 290–300 ml of water and add half a teaspoon of salt, 15–20 g of sugar, 4–5 g of dry yeast (or 12–15 g of fresh yeast), and 20 g of olive oil. Mix well.

Then add 375 g of strong flour with at least 10 g of protein per 100 g. Mix until you get a soft, elastic, and slightly sticky dough.

You can choose between two methods. For the slow method, let the dough rest for about two hours, stretching and folding it every 30 minutes. Then leave it to ferment overnight. This makes the dough light, airy, and flavorful.

For the faster method, skip the overnight fermentation and let the dough rest for a couple of hours before using it.

Next, prepare the sauce with peeled tomatoes, olive oil, salt, a little sugar, oregano, or basil. Cook it briefly until it becomes thick.

Shape the dough into a round flatbread, spread the sauce over it, and add your favorite toppings. You can use mozzarella, salami, fresh basil, or anything you like.

Preheat the oven to about 260°C. Bake the pizza on a preheated stone or tray for 6–7 minutes, until the crust is crispy and the inside is soft and airy.

If you use a traditional pizza oven at 350–400°C, bake it for about 2–3 minutes for an even better result. That’s all – enjoy your meal!

fields.name: Lemon Tart
fields.description: Mix flour, butter, sugar, and egg to make the dough. Bake the dough until light golden. Mix lemon juice, cream, sugar, and eggs for the filling, then bake until set. Beat egg whites with sugar until the meringue is thick and fluffy. Put the meringue on top and bake for a few more minutes. Enjoy your meal.

fields.name: Mushroom Cream Soup
fields.description: Cut the mushrooms, potatoes, and onion into small pieces. Fry the onion, garlic, and mushrooms in olive oil. Add the potatoes and water, then cook until the vegetables are soft. Blend everything until smooth and add cream, Parmesan, salt, and black pepper. Serve warm and enjoy your meal!

fields.name: Lemon Ice Cream
fields.description: Whip the cream with sugar until smooth and slightly thick.Add fresh lemon juice and lemon zest, then mix well.Pour the mixture into a container and freeze for several hours until firm. Let it sit for a few minutes before serving. Enjoy your meal!
